Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to hear how Avery is handling inference routing and cost controls today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Key drivers: reduce per-token inference spend, standardize serving across cloud regions, and centralize observability for model rollouts.
- Primary stakeholders you mentioned: Marcus (VP Product) for feature alignment, and an infra/ops lead for SSO and network constraints.

Next step: a 30-minute product walk-through where we can show the runtime, batching/backpressure controls, and the Console dashboards relevant to your use cases. Proposed slots (all PST):
1) Wed, Dec 15, 10:00–10:30
2) Thu, Dec 16, 13:30–14:00

If neither works, a backup option is Fri, Dec 17, 09:00–09:30.

Please confirm which of the two primary slots works and who from your side should join (Marcus + infra/ops contact would be ideal). On our side I’ll bring Neha (infra/sre) and Ben (solutions engineer) so we can cover SSO / deployment questions.

Prep asks (small):
- Can you share whether you’re evaluating SAML or OIDC for SSO?
- Any network egress restrictions (VPC peering, IP allowlist)?

Attaching a short post-discovery summary and the Redwood security checklist to save time ahead of the demo.

Thanks — happy to adjust slots if you’re in a different timezone.

—Rachel
